about: Every base tree the replay suites under tests/replay load a hook list from (a 40-hex revision named in a replay module), and whether a replayed session keeps that list across the landing (held=kept) or reloads this tree's at it (held=reloaded). Read by tests/test_replay_hook_lists.py: a revision named in a replay module and not registered here fails, an entry whose module no longer names its revision fails, `held` is read from the module's constant `kept_by.constant` (the list is kept exactly when that constant holds `kept_by.key`), and a kept list may name no hooks/ or scripts/ file this tree lacks unless `absent_by_design` lists it with the replay that has that absence as its subject. A reloaded list runs only while the base tree's own files are on disk. `retired` records transitions taken out of the suites, with what is no longer checked.

entries.reason: master's P12-L7 train (#46), the first master list that names no hook file this tree lacks: P12's merge (3a968cf) and the five master lists after it, through 036d1ed, register hooks/posttool-lane-completeness-watch.py by its own path, a file deleted since no session that can still exist holds a list naming it. The oldest list a session that can still exist may hold. Pre-merge, (a) /redev and (b) /dev-overnight run across the landing with it kept, in place of p12 (and before it master and p1b).

Names five retired hook files (notification-idle-overnight, posttool-push-gate-token-verify, posttool-todo-count, posttool-todo-sequence, pretool-push-analyst-grant-guard); no session holding it can still exist. Kept for the replays that reload this tree's list at the landing (a session resumed on old state) and test_obligation_role's old tree.
Names the same five retired hook files as master; no session holding it can still exist. Kept for the replays that reload this tree's list at the landing.

Names the same five retired hook files; no session holding it can still exist. A do-report its /do left `blocked` can still meet this tree, so the `landed` cases stay. No newer list can replace it: since P5 the /do text has no `blocked` terminal, the case's subject.

Names the same five retired hook files; no session holding it can still exist. The subject is P6 landing on subagents registered before P6; a newer base already holds P6, so no newer list can replace it. The `base` cases (this tree's list from the landing on) stay.

retired.no_longer_checked: A session still holding a7d3a9f's hook list after the landing routes its blocked do-report through /close on this tree's text.

A subagent registered under a7d3a9f, its session keeping a7d3a9f's hook list after the landing, meets this tree's hooks (untracked, codex, qa, explore, overnight, grant); and test_the_landed_settings_are_this_trees no longer checks that such a session did not reload its list.

Sessions keeping master's (2acc29b) or p1b's (3f0b7a2) hook list across the landing; run on p12 instead. With them goes the check that the base G2's no-progress stores were on disk at the landing (master only: d625284's G2 wrote them, P1b deleted the writer).

A session that keeps master's (2acc29b) hook list, which sets no CLAUDE_OBLIGATION_STOPGATE, across the landing has F2's invalid dev report stopped by G2 at the dev's stop through the landed settings.json's switch, with and without CLAUDE_HOME. It kept master's list while the register holds master reloaded, and passed only because a file missing from the kept list counts as a block, not an error. Not rebound to p12: 3a968cf's settings.json sets STOPGATE=block, so the subject (a list without the switch) does not exist there; no session holding master's list can still exist.

Sessions keeping the hook list of P12's merge (3a968cf) or of the master commits after it through 036d1ed across the landing: lists that register each hook as its own process (before P12-L7's launchers) and the lane-completeness watch at its path; run on p12l7 (8b27512) instead, whose list registers the launchers. With p12 goes the check that the stub hooks/pretool-bulk-commit-detector.py, which 3a968cf's list names, is on disk.

A session that keeps the pre-update hook list (pre_update_settings: the newest settings.json whose Stop group runs hooks/stop-workflow-coordinator.py directly, beside hooks/stop-do-report-gate.py and hooks/stop-obligation-gate.py; 84de49b) meets this tree's files: its Stop runs every hook of that list without error, holds none of its /dev, /do, /merge spans, and blocks on an open overnight window; its PreToolUse TodoWrite is accepted; and the arming experiment's count of spans option 2 would block. No running session holds that list: every session running on 2026-11-22 started after the installed list became the launcher form (2026-11-21), except one started 2026-08-01, whose list predates the coordinator and both files. The two files are deleted (roundg-delete-list-2), so the list names files this tree lacks. The same five sessions under this tree's list stay (test_a21_this_trees_hook_list_enforces_the_same_spans, the [this tree] cases).

Under the pre-update hook list (84de49b, the same list as test_live_arming's retired cases) with each old bookmark shape seeded: that every hook of every A21 event (five Stops, the compliant and the 2-step-skip TodoWrite, Read/Grep/Glob/Bash/Edit in each session) gives the outcome it gives with no bookmark, without error; that the directly run coordinator holds no span (`would block` advisory); and that tool-policy and todo-validate, each run as its own process at its own path, accept the compliant list and refuse the skip. The only check of the first two was these events. The bookmark-independence of the same hook code stays, under this tree's list (the (this tree) events of both tests): the same hook files run as rules of the launchers. No session that can exist holds 84de49b's list. The July list one idle session holds (34c2b0d03) runs no coordinator and names four files this tree lacks (notification-idle-overnight.py, posttool-todo-count.py, posttool-todo-sequence.py, stop-overnight-timelock.py), so the cases' no-error claim cannot hold there; they were not moved onto it.

That a spec subagent which omits a Role Mandate and records the omission (views/mandate-omissions.json, agents/spec.md R3.4 before the P1b rollback, commits 0bcc38339 and 392176290, intended: the record had no reader) meets a block at its stop that it cannot clear. Since the record is gone the variant replays a valid omission (the monolith has no role annotation for qa): no block, nothing recorded. An omission where the monolith does annotate the agent is checked by the strict verifier's own tests, not by a replay.
